authorization_policy.policy_zh: 本台账仅记录概念阶段的前置条件；在正式场地授权、适用专业审查、运营主体、数据责任、人工复核、停机与退出责任形成可审计且版本化的更新前，不得进行真实场景测试、道路测试、施工、采购或长期运营。
authorization_policy.policy_en: This ledger records concept-stage prerequisites only. Real-world scenario testing, road testing, construction, procurement, and long-term operation are unauthorized until a versioned, auditable update records site authorization, applicable professional review, operator, data responsibility, human review, stop, and exit authority.

在室内或封闭单元启动四个行业测试

Establish four indicator baselines and a scenario registry
Complete ethics, safety, accessibility, data, and exit protocols
Start four industry tests indoors or in contained cells

implementation_phases.land_or_ownership_pathway: 仅使用已获书面许可的室内或可逆临时空间；不推断征拆与权属，具体路径proposed/pending confirmation（A-LAND-001）。
implementation_phases.funding_logic: 建议公共启动资金与参与方实物支持组合；来源与金额proposed/pending confirmation（A-FUND-001），按完成协议和基线里程碑拨付。

场地权属书面同意 / written site-owner consent

decision_gates.metric_or_criterion: 四个行业测试中具备运营者、隐私边界、人工复核和停机方案的比例
decision_gates.continue_condition: 达到100%方可进入跨区测试。

source_lock.binding_note_zh: 当前 source-lock.json 已绑定其字节摘要、几何状态及不可编辑边界层摘要；缺少锁时协议保持阻断。
source_lock.binding_note_en: This protocol binds the source-lock.json byte digest, geometry status, and non-editable layer digests; when the lock is missing the protocol remains blocked.

organizer_trigger.condition_zh: 仅当组织方发布或明确授权的正式几何到达，并能登记发布者、发布日期、文件哈希、坐标系和转换方法时，才触发整体替换。
organizer_trigger.condition_en: Trigger only when organizer-published or explicitly authorized official geometry arrives and its publisher, publication date, file hash, CRS, and transformation method are recorded.
organizer_trigger.arrival_record_requirement_zh: 到达记录必须与正式几何文件及其授权来源一起版本化保存；缺一项不得触发重算。
organizer_trigger.arrival_record_requirement_en: The arrival record must be versioned with the official geometry and its authorization source; missing any field must not trigger recomputation.

participant_action.reason_zh: 当前缺少组织方授权正式几何，参与者不能制造、猜测、替换或单独修复该数据缺口；只能等待组织方数据到达。
participant_action.reason_en: Without organizer-authorized official geometry, the participant cannot manufacture, infer, replace, or independently repair this data gap; it must wait for organizer data.

review_classification.instruction_zh: 官方 AI 审查应将缺少授权正式几何标记为组织方拥有的数据缺口，不得将其转为参与者整改项或要求参与者伪造正式边界。
review_classification.instruction_en: The official AI review must classify missing authorized geometry as an organizer-owned data gap, not a participant repair, and must not require the participant to fabricate an official boundary.

forbidden_shortcuts.rule_zh: 严禁只替换一张背景图或只替换部分边界；正式几何到达后必须按同一原子批次整体重算并重新审核。
forbidden_shortcuts.rule_en: A single-background replacement or partial boundary swap is forbidden. Authorized geometry arrival requires one atomic recomputation batch followed by renewed review.

all_geojson_layers.action_zh: 用授权正式几何整体重建并校验全部九个 GeoJSON 图层；不得只替换背景图层。
all_geojson_layers.action_en: Rebuild and validate all nine GeoJSON layers from the authorized geometry; never replace only a background layer.

verification.method: run the locked validator and persist the passing node record

metrics_areas_ratios.action_zh: 在 EPSG:4548 中整体重算所有指标、面积、长度、比例及其解释，并核对未知项状态。
metrics_areas_ratios.action_en: Recompute every metric, area, length, ratio, and explanation in EPSG:4548, including unknown-status checks.

verification.method: run the locked validator and persist the passing node record

figures.action_zh: 从新 GeoJSON、指标和自检状态重新生成中英文全部图件。
figures.action_en: Regenerate every Chinese and English figure from the new GeoJSON, metrics, and self-check state.

verification.method: run the locked validator and persist the passing node record

a3_a0_pdfs.action_zh: 重新导出并检查中英文 A3 文册和 A0 展板的页数、图位、数值、警示和可读性。
a3_a0_pdfs.action_en: Re-export and inspect the Chinese and English A3 booklets and A0 boards for pagination, figures, values, warnings, and readability.

verification.method: run the locked validator and persist the passing node record

html.action_zh: 重新生成离线中英文 HTML，并检查相对资源路径、图件、数值和临时边界警示。
html.action_en: Regenerate offline Chinese and English HTML and check relative assets, figures, values, and provisional-boundary warnings.

verification.method: run the locked validator and persist the passing node record

phases.action_zh: 同步重算分期、实施前置条件、阶段图层和实施就绪台账，确保几何替换不留下旧阶段证据。
phases.action_en: Recompute phasing, implementation prerequisites, phase layers, and the implementation-readiness ledger so no phase retains stale geometry evidence.

verification.method: run the locked validator and persist the passing node record

manifest_hashes.action_zh: 刷新 manifest 全部文件哈希、协议扩展和生成时间，并验证清单与文件字节一致。
manifest_hashes.action_en: Refresh all manifest file hashes, protocol extensions, and generation time, then verify manifest bytes match the files.

verification.method: run the locked validator and persist the passing node record

self_check.action_zh: 重新运行确定性、空间、视觉和专业自检，并保存通过状态。
self_check.action_en: Rerun deterministic, spatial, visual, and professional self-checks and persist the passing state.

verification.method: run the locked validator and persist the passing node record

final_visual_ai_review.action_zh: 用完整重算后的图件和文档重新执行 final_visual_review；旧审查结果不得复用。
final_visual_ai_review.action_en: Run final_visual_review again on the fully recomputed figures and documents; the old review result must not be reused.

verification.method: run the locked validator and persist the passing node record

official_ai_review.action_zh: 用新绑定的完整包重新执行官方 AI review，并重新分类数据缺口与参与者整改项。
official_ai_review.action_en: Run the official AI review again against the newly bound complete package and reclassify data gaps versus participant repairs.

verification.method: run the locked validator and persist the passing node record

data.method: deterministic inspection of the complete bilingual page/PDF/HTML inventory and declared renderer typography contracts

deterministic.scope: complete 44-page inventory, four PDF records, two offline HTML records, and declared first-page/Phase-0 typography minimums

paid_visual_review.scope: not consumed by this deterministic audit

data.creator_and_method: pipeline-reviewed ImageGen output; no third-party mark, font, photograph, map tile, or person likeness incorporated
data.verification: recheck author, license, attribution, and use restrictions before any public deployment or derivative identity system

data.service_levels: not yet committed; organizer/operator must version response times, escalation, accessibility channel, appeal, correction, withdrawal, and annual review before execution
data.responsible_roles: operator, data steward, accessibility lead, safety/professional reviewer, and appeal owner pending appointment
data.no_claim: The package describes a concept and does not claim that these services are currently delivered.
